page.layout: One printed page: one main text column on the left, with small marginal notes in the right margin. Running head centred at top, page number top right. Signature mark at bottom left.

main_text.p: niam calumniæ reponere cum Christiano indignum sit, jure id fiat an injuria, non melius judicabimus quam si ea quorum nomine Idololatriæ rei peragun-tur, simul congesta lectoris oculis subjiciamus. Ea prout in Saracenicis à Sylburgio editis Euthymii [sic. &c. (neque enim aliorum nobis copia) hæc præcipuè sunt. χαβὲς pro Lucifero & Venere positum, p. 1. & p. 85. ubi qui à Saracenorum dogmatibus ad fidem Christianam conversus fuerit, anathematizare docetur eos qui matutinum sidus sive Luciferum & Venerem adorant, quam Arabum linguâ, χαβὲς (inquit) nominant. Idem p. 71. χαβὲρ effertur, ubi & hæc pro Venerem colentium precationis formula habetur, ᾿Αλλὰ, ἀλλὰ ἀὲ χωβὰρ ἀλλὰ [?]. p. 15. Adhærere eos asserit τῷ λίθῳ τῷ βραχθὰν [?] Lapidi Bractean. Ibidem esse illis ait τὸ Βακχαϊσμακὸν καλούμενον εἴδωλον[?]. Pag. 82. τὸ Βακχα ἢ τοῦ Μάχχε. p. 82. πεφανεῖ-ται τῆς προσ-κυνήματος [?] Simulachrum Baccha Ilmakeech dictum, quod ipse (Mohammedes sc. σεβάσμα προσκυνήματος [?]) Adoramen observationis appellat, & ut miseri barbari adorarent præcepit. Ibid. [illegible, ~12 letters] i.e. sed & duo vocabula barbara Tzitzapha, & Marua, (p. 78. Tzapha & Marua) ex iis in quibus Deus colitur esse dicit. p. 85. in medio domus precationis Mache jacere ait lapidem magnum Veneris effigiem in se habentem; honorari autem istum lapidem quasi Abraham super eo cum Agare coierit, aut Camelum ei alligaverit cum Isacum sacrificatu-rus erat.

Hæc præcipuè sunt quorum nomine Mohammedis sectatores Idololatriæ rei peraguntur. Quid verò de his statuendum sit, ubi Arabice expressa fuerint quæ Euthymius cæterique Græcè protulerunt, meliùs pa-tebit,

page.notes: Right margin: a single dot near the top is a speck, not printed text, so it is left out. The marginal note beside the "Ibidem esse illis" lines is hard to read; the Greek is only partly legible and is marked [?]. The Greek in the paragraph on "᾿Αλλὰ" and "βραχθὰν" is also doubtful. The phrase "Ilmakeech" is an uncertain reading of a Hebrew-style name. "[illegible, ~12 letters]" replaces a small Greek fragment that could not be read. The last line runs into the signature Q; "tebit," is the last full line of the column. Show-through and the faint scan edge at the right are not transcribed.
